trainer/32215.htm.text: Master Tenain: Ah, welcome! I've been so absent-minded lately that I didn't even notice you there. If you look around Giran, you'll understand why. It's like this all day long: noise and crowds and chaos! It is very different from my own orderly homeland. Ah, you came for training? Good. I need som…

trainer/32215-noteach.htm.text: Master Tenain: You want to study under me? Sorry, but that is impossible. I might look like a soft-hearted Kamael to you, but I never disobey orders -- and my orders are to teach only Troopers, Berserkers and Soul Breakers.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-01.html.text: Master Tenain: You say Master Orkurus sent you? You must be hoping to join the guild. How fortunate! I am in need of someone with your skills. We have been tasked with the protection of an important item, but our enemy seems to have caught wind of it and is preparing to attack. Help us defend the i…

links.text: Agree to help with the mission.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-03.html.text: Master Tenain: Go to the Breka Stronghold and defeat the Breka Orcs, the Breka Orc Archers, the Breka Orc Warriors, the Breka Orc Shamans and the Breka Orc Overlords . Slay them and bring back 20 Breka Orc heads as proof.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-04.html.text: Master Tenain: I see you have defeated the Breka Orcs as ordered. Well done! Unfortunately, the enemy has learned the location of the item. We will face more than simply Breka Orcs in the future... We are in the process of moving the item to a safer location. Those entrusted with doing so just left…

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-05.html.text: Master Tenain: We are moving the item to a safer location. Those entrusted with doing so just left, so please follow them and help. They should be near Death Pass by now.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-06.html.text: Master Tenain: What is it? It seems too soon for you to have safely transported the item to its destination and returned...

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-11.html.text: Master Tenain: Please help Master Entien of Dion Castle Village stop the enemy raiders from alerting their main force about the location of the item. I will track the transportation team.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-12.html.text: Master Tenain: I already heard. Thank you. Meanwhile, we found another message plate left by the transportation team that revealed that they were moving towards the Plains of the Lizardmen. We hurriedly sent reinforcements, but they were destroyed after a fierce battle. The transportation unit was …

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-13.html.text: Master Tenain: Go the Plains of the Lizardmen, defeat our enemies and rescue Harkilgamed.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-14.html.text: Master Tenain: You have returned alreay? What has happened?

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-16.html.text: Master Tenain: Take this letter of recommendation to Master Olkrus.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-02.html.text: Master Tenain: Yes, sir. Here is the situation, then: The Breka Orcs have launched a series of attacks to steal the item we are protecting. We do not have the numbers for a static defense, so we have determined to go on the offensive and attack their stronghold to throw them into confusion. Go to t…

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-07.html.text: Master Tenain: The transportation team was attacked?! Show me the message plate right away! That is our only clue...

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-08.html.text: Master Tenain: It is coded. Wait while I decode the message. . . . Oh, what a relief! It seems that the item has not been captured by the enemy...yet. I will tell you the details.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-09.html.text: Master Tenain: We have avoided the brunt of the raiders' attack and are withdrawing secretly. However, they have dispatched a small force to alert the main enemy units of our location. First, we must eliminate that force before they contact the main enemy group. They moved off to the west, so I con…

links.text: Ask what should be done now.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-10.html.text: Master Tenain: Under the bridge... I think I know what he refers to. I will track the transportation team. Please help Master Entien of Dion Castle Village stop the enemy raiders from alerting their main force about the location of the item.

Q00064_CertifiedBerserker/32215-15.html.text: Master Tenain: I see. Well done! The mission has finally been successfully completed. As promised, I will give you a letter of recommendation to take to Master Olkrus. Many thanks for your aid!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
